name: The Last of Us Part II

locations.note: Joel and Ellie have built a life in Jackson when Joel and Tommy rescue a stranger, Abby, who beats Joel to death at her group's outpost while Ellie watches.

In flashbacks, Ellie travels to the Fireflies' old hospital in Salt Lake City and learns the truth about what Joel did there; Abby's own memories go back to the day Joel killed her father, the surgeon, in that hospital.

Ellie and Dina follow Tommy to Seattle, torn by war between the WLF militia and the Seraphite cult; Abby's three days, played after Ellie's, follow her from the WLF to the Seraphite island with the runaways Yara and Lev.
Ellie and Dina cross the overgrown Capitol Hill district on their first day in Seattle, hunting for Abby's crew.
The WLF has turned the stadium into its fortified base, where Abby's days in Seattle begin.
Ellie and Dina hole up in the old theatre, and it is here that Abby finally catches up with them.
The aquarium is Owen's hideout, where he plans to sail for Santa Barbara; Ellie tracks him and Mel there and kills them, and Abby comes back to find them dead.
The slaver Rattlers capture Abby and Lev in Santa Barbara; Ellie frees them, fights Abby in the surf and spares her, and Abby and Lev sail for the Fireflies on Catalina Island.

routes.name: Ellie
routes.note: From Joel's death outside Jackson to three days of revenge in Seattle and the last fight on the beach at Santa Barbara.

routes.name: Abby
routes.note: From the killing in Jackson back to the WLF's war in Seattle, the aquarium and the Rattlers' camp at Santa Barbara.
